 Tulane 31, Texas-San Antonio 24
 This is a vote of confidence in Tulane quarterback Trace Johnson, a freshman who is mature beyond his years, and a defense that destroyed Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes last week. The pass rush will not have the same effect on UTSA quarterback Owen McCown, who gets the ball out quickly, but if it pressures him into even a few mistakes, the Green Wave should be in good shape. Although the Roadrunners have improved away from home, they still struggle to match their Alamodome dominance on both sides of the ball.
